_comment: Golden contract for Markdown IMPORT (invariant 3, CLAUDE.md lockstep rule): TS markdownToDocument (src/markdown.ts parseMarkdownBlocks, GUI) and Rust markdown_text_to_document (src-tauri/src/fileio.rs, CLI/MCP import) must produce exactly `title` and the (type, level, content) chunk sequence for each `md`, given `fallbackTitle` as the previous/file-stem title. Read by src/markdownImportParity.test.ts and fileio.rs tests::md_import_golden_parity. Deliberately EXCLUDED because the parsers differ by design or the behavior is planned: YAML frontmatter (GUI-only; Rust keeps it as text), image lines (TS makes image chunks; Rust keeps them as text), an indented first-line H1 (Rust trims it into the title; TS treats it as a body heading), empty ATX headings such as '## ' or '## #' (planned), lone-CR line endings (TS splits on \r; Rust str::lines does not), and indented fences.
